Strong background in Agile delivery, project management, resource planning, and operational excellence.SKILLSPROFESSIONAL SUMMARYPROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE+91 798 553 8045 | vishalchakravorty5@gmail.com | Bangalore, IndiaVishal ChakravortySenior Consultant - Package Implementation (WorkFront)LTI Mindtree, Bangalore India

Administered Adobe Workfront environments including user setup, access controls, custom forms, project templates, request queues, portfolios, andgovernance structures.

Designed and implemented 200+ Adobe Workfront workflows and Adobe Fusion automation scenarios, improving operational efficiency by 35%.

Developed and maintained Fusion integrations using REST APIs, JSON payloads, and webhooks for seamless synchronization across enterpriseapplications.

Configured approval workflows, intake processes, SLA tracking mechanisms, and automated notifications to improve project visibility andcompliance.

Integrated Adobe Workfront with Microsoft Office 365 and enterprise reporting systems, reducing manual effort by 40%.

Built executive dashboards and operational reports for portfolio-level tracking, resource utilization, and project health monitoring.

Collaborated with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into scalable Workfront solutions.

Conducted Workfront user training sessions and developed technical documentation, SOPs, and governance standards.

Provided production support, root cause analysis, and issue resolution for Workfront and Fusion-related incidents.

Partnered with solution architects and technical teams to implement enterprise workflow automation initiatives.April 2025 - PresentAdobe Workfront & Fusion Consultant | Workflow Automation & Integration SpecialistDivisional Program Manager - New InitiativesMygate, Bangalore IndiaMarch 2024 - October 2024

Designed and administered Workfront request queues supporting 1,300+ project submissions across multiple business functions.

Configured custom intake forms, approval workflows, project templates, and reporting dashboards for enterprise project governance.

Implemented Adobe Fusion automations to streamline ERP enhancement requests and project release workflows.

Developed executive dashboards for portfolio tracking, project prioritization, resource planning, and dependency management.

Launched a monthly training series for stakeholders on Workfront best practices, creating SOPs and FAQs to ensure self-sufficiency and issueresolution.

Improved project efficiency by 12% through Workfront standardization and strategic prioritization. January 2022 - February 2024Senior Program Manager - Client Delight & GrowthMygate, Bangalore, India

Migrated 2000 JIRA projects to Workfront, standardizing processes to reduce project setup time by 50% and boost workflow efficiency by 40%.

Defined and tracked team goals via Workfront’s Goals feature, leveraging a red/yellow/green system to enhance leadership intervention efficiencyby 40% and achieve 98% goal completion.

Optimized ERP enhancements and Client Engagement Program with Workfront Fusion, automating GitHub updates in Workfront to acceleraterollouts, boosting adoption by 30% and user satisfaction by 25%.

Developed Workfront dashboards for tracking, increasing SLA adherence by 17% and optimizing project management across teams.

Built interactive Power BI dashboards by integrating Workfront data with Google Sheets, providing real-time insights into project progress, resourceallocation, and workload distribution.

Configured Workfront reporting and dashboard solutions to provide real-time visibility into project performance and resource allocation.February 2021 - December 2021Program Manager - Client Engagement ProgramMygate, Bangalore, India

Directed PAN India teams for Dyson, Dominos, and BMW, driving Rs. 5 Cr. monthly revenue by creating Workfront dashboards and optimizingoperational efficiency.

Audited campaign P&L to secure 40% profitability and engineered a Workfront dashboard to improve visibility and reduce errors between Brand andClient Managers.

Streamlined complex Workfront projects into actionable tasks, ensuring timely execution and recognized with the SPOT Award in September 2022for exceptional performance.

November 2019 - January 2021

Led global product launches of Super-Kiddos & Super-Moms projects and achieving a 30% increase in adoption through timely delivery and localizedfeatures.

Spearheaded onboarding partner academies and generated new leads, boosting feature adoption by 18% through targeted education and drivingrevenue with tailored upsell strategies.

Analyzed data reports and planned the organization's MIS.Operations ManagerMachaxi, Bangalore, IndiaEDUCATION BSc : National Council of Hospitality and Catering Technology - AhmedabadMarch 2015 - May 2018
